activity: Confirm approved change record
success_criteria: Change record names scope window risk and rollback authority

activity: Confirm in-scope customers sites and endpoints
success_criteria: Every target is listed and exclusions are explicit

activity: Confirm maintenance window and timezone
success_criteria: Window is recorded in UTC and local customer time

activity: Name go no-go and rollback decision owners
success_criteria: Primary and backup decision owners acknowledge responsibility

activity: Export current endpoint and policy inventory
success_criteria: Baseline export is timestamped and stored

activity: Verify backup or recovery path for affected systems
success_criteria: Recovery evidence is current and restorable
rollback_action: Pause change and restore recovery readiness

activity: Validate installer package checksum and signing
success_criteria: Package source signature and checksum match approved values
rollback_action: Quarantine package and stop deployment

activity: Verify required firewall proxy and allow-list paths
success_criteria: Pilot endpoints can reach required services
rollback_action: Restore prior network rule and stop deployment

activity: Confirm monitoring suppression and alert-routing plan
success_criteria: Planned noise is suppressed without hiding unrelated incidents
rollback_action: Remove suppression and restore prior routing

activity: Send pre-change notice
success_criteria: Required stakeholders receive timing impact and contact details
rollback_trigger: Required approver objects or cannot be reached
rollback_action: Pause change pending approval

activity: Deploy to pilot endpoints
success_criteria: All pilot endpoints install and check in within target time
rollback_trigger: Pilot install or check-in failure exceeds threshold
rollback_action: Remove new agent and restore prior configuration

activity: Validate endpoint identity and tenant assignment
success_criteria: Every pilot endpoint appears once under the correct customer and site
rollback_action: Stop rollout and correct identity mapping

activity: Validate health inventory alerts and service status
success_criteria: Required telemetry is current and expected test alerts route correctly
rollback_trigger: Telemetry stale or alert routing incorrect
rollback_action: Revert policies and remove pilot agent

activity: Validate approved script or automation on pilot
success_criteria: Test action runs only on intended endpoint and records result
rollback_action: Disable automation and revert action

activity: Record pilot go no-go decision
success_criteria: Decision owner records proceed pause or rollback with evidence
rollback_action: Execute documented rollback

activity: Deploy first production wave
success_criteria: Wave completes within error and timing thresholds
rollback_action: Stop queue and roll back failed wave

activity: Reconcile first wave before continuing
success_criteria: Target installed checked-in failed and excluded counts balance
rollback_action: Pause next wave and investigate

activity: Deploy remaining approved waves
success_criteria: Each wave starts only after prior wave approval
rollback_trigger: Prior wave lacks approval or unresolved exception
rollback_action: Pause deployment queue

activity: Validate patch service alert and remote-support workflows
success_criteria: Representative workflows succeed across each wave
rollback_action: Stop change and invoke rollback decision

activity: Confirm no unintended service degradation
success_criteria: Baseline and post-change indicators remain within accepted range
rollback_trigger: Severity-one or defined degradation threshold reached
rollback_action: Execute rollback and incident process

activity: Stop active deployment and automation queues
success_criteria: No new targets receive the change
rollback_action: Isolate deployment credentials and escalate

activity: Remove or revert changed components
success_criteria: Affected endpoints return to the approved prior state
rollback_trigger: Rollback fails on any critical endpoint
rollback_action: Open incident and use recovery path

activity: Restore prior policy routing and suppression state
success_criteria: Prior monitoring and routing configuration is active
rollback_action: Escalate to monitoring owner and incident process

activity: Send outcome or rollback notice
success_criteria: Stakeholders receive status impact exceptions and next update time
rollback_action: Send corrected notice immediately

activity: Reconcile exceptions and assign owners
success_criteria: Every failed excluded offline or unknown endpoint has owner and due date
rollback_action: Keep change open and assign owner

activity: Attach evidence and close change record
success_criteria: Approvals timeline results exceptions and lessons are attached
rollback_action: Return record to validation

activity: Record signed rollback authorization
success_criteria: Authorization identifies failed release affected cohort approved target version and decision owner
rollback_trigger: Authorization is missing expired or targets an unapproved version
rollback_action: Stop rollback and escalate to change authority

activity: Verify post-rollback binary version hash and signer
success_criteria: Installed binary matches the approved rollback manifest and trusted signer
evidence: Post-rollback hash signature and version evidence
rollback_trigger: Hash signer or version does not match approved target
rollback_action: Isolate endpoint and open manual recovery

activity: Reconcile every endpoint into a final recovery state
success_criteria: Every target is approved-new approved-prior isolated-manual-recovery or still-unknown
rollback_trigger: Any target is absent or unclassified
rollback_action: Keep incident and change open with named owner

activity: Prove the rollout stopped at the approved boundary
success_criteria: Deployment evidence shows no later cohort received the failed release
rollback_trigger: Later cohort received or may have received the failed release
rollback_action: Expand incident scope and investigate all exposed endpoints
